dog.description_text: Meet Phoenix, a handsome boy who has done well with both staff and volunteers! Phoenix is very active and playful and enjoys spending time where people are. He is easygoing when it comes to grooming and allows his owner/family to bathe and brush him. Phoenix does well on leash with very little pulling and enjoys getting out for walks. He used to be crated but does not need a crate now. Phoenix loves car rides and would be happy to join you on adventures. He knows several cues, including sit, stay, and give me the paw. His previous owner's favorite things about him were that he likes to play and go for walks. With his playful personality and love of people and adventures, Phoenix is ready to find his forever home!
dog.name: Phoenix
